REPRESENTATIVE FOR ALLIED UNIVERSAL, PRANIL SHANKAR IS ABLE TO VERIFY THAT THE CORRECT NAME OF THE BUSINESS ENTITY DOING BUSINESS IN CALIFORNIA IS UNIVERSAL PROTECTION SECURITY SYSTEMS DBA ALLIED UNIVERSAL LLP, WHICH IS REQISTERED WITH THE SECRETARY OF STATE OF CALIFORNIA. COURT STATES THAT IT IS INCLINED TO DISMISS DEFENDANT ALLIED UNIVERSAL WITH PREJUDICE. DEFENDANTS ARE INSTRUCTED TO UPDATE THEIR INFORMATION AS TO THE THE CORRECT NAME OF THE DEFENDANTS IN ROOM 103. . PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS ARE REVEIWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT.
